meaningKo: 비용이나 시간을 아끼기 위해 대충 하다, 절차를 간소화하다
exampleEn: We shouldn't cut corners on the project if we want it to succeed.
exampleKo: 프로젝트가 성공하기를 원한다면 대충 해서는 안 된다.
gameExamples: It's tempting to cut corners when you're in a hurry, but it usually leads to mistakes.
To save money, some companies choose to cut corners, which can hurt their reputation.
If we cut corners during the construction, the quality of our building will suffer.
